run_f_gold: run f_gold to find the longest strict bitonic subsequence length in an array
test_f_gold: test f_gold against f_filled using the built-in parameter sets and print results
review_f_gold: review f_gold algorithm that computes longest strict bitonic subsequence using increasing and decreasing passes
summarize_f_gold: summarize f_gold which finds the longest bitonic subsequence by combining forward increasing and backward decreasing lengths
refactor_f_gold: refactor f_gold to replace the dict-based lookup with a more efficient LIS approach
